newsitem.title: UK: Burford to buy four retail parks from Morrison.
newsitem.headline: Burford to buy four retail parks from Morrison.

text.p: Burford Holdings plc said on Tuesday it was to buy four retail properties from Morrison Construction Group plc for about 65.5 million stg.

Under the agreement, Burford will buy from Morrison the properties under four separate deals, as follows: Meadowbank Retail Park, Edinburgh, a 135,500 sq ft city centre retail and leisure development; The Octagon, Stoke, a mixed retail and leisure park of 110,000 sq ft; Walsall Phase 2, a 103,000 sq ft non-food retail development adjacent to a 60,000 sq ft Sainsbury foodstore being constructed by Morrison Construction Ltd. and a newly acquired development at Hull which will provide 102,000 sq ft of non-food retail.
Burford said it will pay Morrison an element of the capital value on a scheme by scheme basis linked to lettings. The balance will be payable as lettings are progressed over time.
